# Chinese Tea Guide

Your practical guide to Chinese tea — the six major types, 21 famous teas with brewing and buying guides, tea regions, brewing methods, tea culture, and how to choose the right tea.

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://chin-tea.com
- The Six Types: https://chin-tea.com/types

  - White Tea: https://chin-tea.com/types/white

  - Black Tea: https://chin-tea.com/types/black

- Famous Teas: https://chin-tea.com/teas
  - Best Chinese Teas (ranked picks): https://chin-tea.com/best-teas
  - 21 tea pages with flavor profile, brewing parameters, buying tips, and common scams (e.g. https://chin-tea.com/teas/longjing)

## About

This site is built to help English-speaking tea lovers discover the world of Chinese tea through practical, experience-based information — exact brewing temperatures, realistic price ranges, quality checks, and common scams to avoid. No sponsored recommendations.
